title: Revalidate continuous owner authority at every effect boundary
summary: Human-approved managed work must retain immutable scope and plan bindings, while each controller command and evidence write rechecks current authority and ownership.
reusable_steps: Human-approved managed work must retain immutable scope and plan bindings, while each controller command and evidence write rechecks current authority and ownership
expected_outcome: Route reviewed project and mission-group plans through human approval and an owner-only execution port; ordinary workers must reject managed bindings. Rebind to the original charter role and revalidate current charter, approval hash, claim, lease, halt and deadline immediately before each child command, evidence write and approval creation, and again after awaited effects before checkpoint completion. Preserve uncertain effect ownership while quarantining invalid work so later valid work is not starved. Stop detached controller process groups on abort, deadline and parent exit. Use machine-only stored gates and immutable alignment briefs. Test cleanup must be restricted to uniquely constructed job paths and files actually created; transpilation is not typechecking. Shared temporary storage remains disposable and cannot be the only evidence store.
